title: Evidence record (one line of measurements.jsonl)
description: One number measured inside a highlight, or the honest statement that it is unavailable (ADR 0004, docs/design/m1-highlights.md). evidenceId is the sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8, no NaN) of the record without evidenceId, so any change to a record changes its id. Speeds are stored in m/s (km/h only in display); pitch quantities are SoccerNet metres measured only on pitch-usable frames (gate G6); image-plane quantities carry plane 'image' and are never converted to metres. A missing value is status 'unavailable' with value null and a reasonCode, never zero. C-tier metrics are never written: the tier enum leaves C out on purpose. error.kind is 'unmeasured' unless a receipt measured the metric's error.

evidenceId.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of this record without the evidenceId key.

metric_id.description: Metric id: the id in registries/metrics.toml when the metric is listed there, otherwise a gbf.measure id.

tier.description: From registries/metrics.toml when the metric is listed (tier_source 'registry'); otherwise 'B' (experimental) or 'image_plane' (an image measurement, not a body or pitch quantity), set explicitly (tier_source 'explicit'). C is blocked and never written.

claimType.description: measurement: computed from tracking and calibration; estimate: a model-based or heuristic estimate (3D height-prior skeleton, contact frame); image_measurement: measured in the image plane; provider_model / official_fact: a provider's value.

value.description: The value in storage units (unit), or null when unavailable.

unit.description: m/s (speeds; km/h only on screen), m, deg, count, frame (a canonical frame index), box_h (image distance in box heights of the players involved), bh/s (image speed in box heights per second at the ball's own scale), or empty.

display.description: Display text (km/h for speeds, mm:ss.cc times), or an em dash when unavailable.

frame.description: Canonical frame the value refers to (the key, contact or peak frame); null when no frame applies.

frames.description: Canonical frames whose data entered the value (or were examined, when unavailable), sorted.

track_id.description: The player the value belongs to (tracks.parquet track_id), or null.

track_ids.description: Every track whose data entered the value (the subject first).

plane.description: pitch: SoccerNet metres or the calibrated 3D layer; image: measured in the image plane.

quality.description: Flat evidence about how good the value is (sample counts, spreads, gates, box heights). Values are numbers, strings, booleans, null or flat arrays of them.

error.description: ADR 0004 section 3. measured needs a receiptId; unmeasured carries no numbers.

coverage.description: How much of the highlight window the value is based on (ADR 0004: A tier always with coverage).

source.description: The canonical video and the run artifacts the record was computed from, by sha256 (names only, never paths).
